title: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when applying valid promotional code RESCUE20 during checkout
symptoms: Customers attempting to checkout with the valid promotional code RESCUE20 receive a generic HTTP 500 Internal Server Error screen. Cart items are not purchased, order ID is not generated, and checkout fails completely.
reproduction_steps: Start the checkout service with `uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`.
Send an HTTP POST request to `http://localhost:8000/checkout`.
Include a valid checkout request payload with customer ID, items, shipping address, payment method, and set `promo_code` to 'RESCUE20'.
Observe the HTTP response status code and response payload.
expected_behavior: The checkout request should succeed with HTTP 200 OK. The service should apply a 20% discount to the subtotal, calculate sales tax on the discounted subtotal, generate an order ID, and return a confirmed CheckoutResponse.
actual_behavior: The checkout request fails with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. The application raises an unhandled KeyError: 'discount_percent' in `app/service.py` within `apply_discount()` because the dictionary in `ACTIVE_PROMOTIONS` defines the discount under the key 'rate' instead of 'discount_percent'.
